test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The old man shared his ________ wisdom with the young generation.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Sagacious**" means having or showing keen mental discernment and good judgment; wise.
 
• This fits the context perfectly as the old man is sharing wise and profound insights with the young generation.
 
• The other options (trivial, ephemeral, frivolous) do not convey the intended meaning of wisdom and insight.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trivial:** Means of little value or importance, which is not suitable for describing wisdom.
 
• **Ephemeral:** Means lasting for a very short time, which does not fit the context of wisdom.
 
• **Frivolous:** Means not having any serious purpose or value, which is contrary to the idea of wisdom.
